proposals.evidence: DEDR5373 documents Tamil/Malayalam vāḻai/vāḻa, Kannada bāḻe and Kota vāy vaṇ plantain; DEDR4004 independently documents paḻam/paṇ/paṇṇu fruit, including Irula pammu/pāmu and Kota paṇ. Propose the ordered banana-plant + ripe-fruit components for these surveyed whole words. Their lateral/rhotic/glide, p/h and final-vowel differences are preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis for this survey lect, not a claim that every spelling or lect is printed in DEDR; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. More heavily contracted forms without two identifiable constituents are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Muduga mukaḷkūrɛ roof is analysed comparatively as mukaḷ top/ridge (DEDR4888, Malayalam mukaḷ) + kūrɛ roof (DEDR1904, Tamil kūrai and Malayalam kūra). Both survey constituents are preserved in order; this proposes a transparent regional compound, not a claim that DEDR prints the entire Muduga form.

Propose ordered inside + hand components, with contraction of akam in the compound. Survey minority-lect forms are comparative extensions and retain their original vowels and hand-stem endings.

Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3918 explicitly gives Tamil paṉṉ-iraṇṭu/paṉṉaṇṭu twelve, the Kannada pann- combining form of ten and Kodagu panneraṇḍï; DEDR474 supplies two and the corresponding numeral formations. Propose ordered ten + two, retaining assimilation, Kannada h-/zero-initial variants and the survey vowel notation. These are whole-numeral comparative analyses, with no truncation of source responses; contact-sensitive Gondi/Gadaba/Konda sets are excluded.
